entities.name: RNA polymerase omega
observations: 82-residue protein; exact sequence match to curated Synechococcus sp. CC9902 Q3AZJ0.
Promotes bacterial RNA polymerase assembly by latching the N- and C-terminal regions of the beta-prime subunit and facilitating interactions with beta and alpha subunits.
Contains Pfam RNA_pol_Rpb6 domain PF01192.28 at residues 25-74.
The omega subunit is not itself the catalytic polymerase component; catalytic activity belongs to the assembled RNA polymerase complex.
